title: Intacct Fundamentals at Greens
description: How Greens' ledger in Sage Intacct reaches you through Nexus Accounting, and nothing else: one ledger and two doors, entities and child codes, dimensions, journals and books, the reports and the drill-down, vendors and customers and their papers, MRI, MRE and loans, Ask My Accountant and the audit pages, the dashboard, the close and the tools. Course 9 of the Academy.
overview: One ledger, two doors: Intacct, the accounting app and Nexus Accounting
Entities, sub-entities and child codes, consolidation and entity access
Dimensions: one account read by site, vendor, department or job
Journals and books, statistical journals, the Books picker
Report Center, the drill-down, Report Builder and Packages
Vendors and customers, requests and the Compliance tab, leasing tenants
MRI, MRE, Loans with planning and stress, management fees
Ask My Accountant, the reclass push, Manual Journal Entries, payroll pages
The Dashboard tabs, the Close tab, Budget, Allocations and Import Hub

lessons.checkpoint: Checkpoint: The Ledger and Its Reports

questions.q: Where do Greens' books live?
options: In Sage Intacct; Nexus reads a mirror of the ledger
questions.explanation: One ledger. Nexus never writes to Intacct and never keeps a second set of books.

questions.q: A site manager has the Accounting grant and one entity. Which does she see?
questions.explanation: The grant opens the module; the entity list says what she reads. The Dashboard tabs are consolidated and need All Entities.

questions.q: What is 15001-1?
questions.explanation: A child code carries its parent's code with a suffix; the parent brings its children.

questions.q: One repairs account can be read by site because:
options: There is a repairs account per site
Every ledger line carries dimensions, such as the entity, and reports filter by them
questions.explanation: Dimensions tag every line: entity, department, vendor, customer, employee, Project-Job, item, journal.

questions.q: A statistical journal:
options: Adds square feet into the money total
Carries quantities and never adds into a money total
questions.explanation: It lets a report divide dollars by a quantity without changing a dollar.

questions.q: Reading a report on Both means:
options: Accrual and cash side by side, two reads of the ledger
questions.explanation: The quickest way to see whether a month's gap between profit and cash is receivables, payables or a capital spend.

questions.q: What does a posted figure on any Nexus Accounting report do when clicked?
options: Opens its General Ledger lines, each of which opens its entry
questions.explanation: The drill-down rule, everywhere; only a worked-out figure such as a budget stays plain.

questions.q: A memorized report with a named period such as Last Quarter:
options: Moves with the calendar, so it is right next quarter untouched
questions.explanation: That is also why a lender's Package builds itself.

lessons.checkpoint: Checkpoint: Records, Questions and the Close

questions.q: A new vendor requested in Nexus reads what until the record exists in the ledger?
options: Pending Approval, then Approved, Awaiting Intacct
questions.explanation: No invoice is paid to a name that is only a request.

questions.q: Which tab on a vendor record is Nexus's own, not Intacct's?
questions.explanation: Details are the ledger's; Compliance holds the insurance certificate, workers comp, license and W-9.

questions.q: Rent received on a lease in MRI comes from:
options: What posted to the lease's income accounts for that customer in that month
questions.explanation: A leasing tenant is an Intacct customer; nobody keys a lease payment into Nexus.

questions.q: A loan payment belongs in:
questions.explanation: Debt service is Loans, with amortization, planning and stress.

questions.q: Who may push a GL reclass to the ledger?
questions.explanation: Anyone may ask; only the bookkeeper pushes. Neil's decision, 10/22/2026.

questions.q: The Manual Journal Entries page lists:
options: Only the entries a person keyed or changed by hand, with who did it
questions.explanation: The audit page for segregation of duties.

questions.q: Managers see pay on the Payroll & People reports.
questions.explanation: Managers never see pay; the payroll pages open for the accounting team and the payroll step-up.

questions.q: What does Import Hub do with a bank statement?
options: Turns it into an Intacct import template the accounting team posts
questions.explanation: Nexus prepares, previews and exports; the accounting team posts.

questions.q: Nexus Accounting writes to Intacct when a manager edits a figure.
questions.explanation: Nothing in Nexus is typed into the ledger. A change is asked for through Ask My Accountant.

questions.q: Personal financial statements open for:
options: Owners and the PFS grant only
questions.explanation: Whatever a person's tier.

questions.q: The Greens Accounting app is:
options: The standalone app, built to look like Intacct, where the accounting team works in the ledger
questions.explanation: Reached from Nexus with Launch.

questions.q: Which groups does the Accounting module have? Pick all that apply.
questions.explanation: Five groups; there is no entry screen in Nexus.

questions.q: Family and personal entities are:
options: In the same ledger as the companies, read by the few the Access page names
questions.explanation: That is why entity access exists.

questions.q: A report run consolidated shows:
options: Every entity the person may read, added up with intercompany removed
questions.explanation: The Dashboard tabs are consolidated views.

questions.q: Entities are created:
options: In Intacct by the accounting team; Nexus lists them
questions.explanation: The Entities page is a reference, never an editor.

questions.q: Which dimension carries a construction job's costs?
questions.explanation: Everything a job cost, however many vendors.

questions.q: A gate repair billed with no ticket number is coded:
options: To the account the invoice suggests and the entity the vendor usually serves, right most of the time
questions.explanation: The tenth time it lands on the wrong site.

questions.q: Buckets groups an account's lines by:
options: One dimension: vendor, customer, department, Project-Job, item or entity
questions.explanation: Repairs by vendor; payroll by department; cost by job.

questions.q: Which journal carries vendor invoices and payments?
questions.explanation: Accounts payable.

questions.q: A user-defined book is:
options: Accrual plus that book's own journals, kept for a purpose
questions.explanation: Named by the accounting team; travels by its key.

questions.q: Which book do Greens' statements use by default?
questions.explanation: Accrual tells the truth about a month; cash is read beside it.

questions.q: Row groups in Report Builder:
options: Gather several accounts under one named total
questions.explanation: A nonstandard report is built by the person who knows the mapping, never in code.

questions.q: A published Report Builder report is seen by:
options: Its author until it is shared with everyone
questions.explanation: Save keeps a draft; Publish marks it; Share With Everyone opens it to the grant holders.

questions.q: Report columns in Nexus Accounting:
options: Resize and keep each person's widths
questions.explanation: The house rule for every report.

questions.q: A Package is:
options: A lender's set of memorized reports built to one PDF
questions.explanation: Named periods make it right next quarter untouched.

questions.q: Most Greens tenants are Intacct customers.
questions.explanation: Most tenants live in Cubby; a leasing tenant is the exception.

questions.q: Which page is the chart of accounts as the ledger holds it?
questions.explanation: Number, name, kind, active, and the lines posted for the period.

questions.q: A vendor's Ledger Lines tab shows:
options: Every line posted to that vendor across the entities you may read, each opening its entry
questions.explanation: The same drill-down, gathered for one vendor.

questions.q: MRE stands for:
questions.explanation: A vendor paid on a schedule from the same accounts, expected beside actual.

questions.q: A lease whose tenant leaves is:
options: Ended, and the new tenant is a new line
questions.explanation: The history stands.

questions.q: What does Stress on a loan show?
options: What a higher rate does to the payment and the debt service coverage
questions.explanation: Worked out from the terms, never posted.

questions.q: A management fee on a site's income statement is:
options: What the operating company charges a property entity for running it
questions.explanation: Management Fees holds the agreements.

questions.q: Ask My Accountant lines show the Other Side, which is:
options: The account the money came from or went to, read from the entry
questions.explanation: So the question can be answered without a second click.

questions.q: A question about a ledger line is best asked:
options: On the line, so the answer and the fix live together
questions.explanation: Open to Answered to Resolved, on the line.

questions.q: Profitability compares:
options: Entities on revenue, operating expenses, NOI and margin
questions.explanation: The four ratios for every site at once.

questions.q: Allocations spreads wages by:
options: Each person's hours by work site from the Time Clock
questions.explanation: One more reason the Time Sheet is signed, approved and right.

questions.q: The Dashboard's figures are:
options: Read from the accounting app's dashboard, never computed or typed in Nexus
questions.explanation: Anything written from the dashboard carries the writer's name.

questions.q: What does a site owe the close? Pick all that apply.
options: Tickets resolved for a clean cut-off
questions.explanation: Four things, in order of how often they slow a close down.

questions.q: The budget column on the Budget page:
options: Does not drill, because a budget is worked out, not posted
questions.explanation: The actual column drills.

questions.q: The pattern of every Tools page is:
options: Nexus prepares, previews and exports; the accounting team posts
questions.explanation: The one-door rule, kept.

questions.q: Consolidated means:
options: Everything the person may read, added up with intercompany removed
questions.explanation: The Dashboard tabs; a report with no entity chosen.

questions.q: Debt service coverage is:
questions.explanation: What the lender watches; Loans > Stress.

questions.q: A GL Reclass is:
options: A request to move a line to another account, pushed only by the bookkeeper
questions.explanation: Ask My Accountant.

questions.q: Entity access takes effect:
questions.explanation: Reports, search, drill-downs and journal entries all stop at the list.

questions.q: A parent entity report includes its sub-entities.
questions.explanation: A parent brings its children; filter to the child for the finer cut.

questions.q: Which filters appear on every report page? Pick all that apply.
questions.explanation: Every Intacct dimension as a filter.

questions.q: The Trial Balance shows:
options: Every account's debit or credit balance
questions.explanation: Where the accounting team starts the close.

questions.q: A statistical journal's lines appear in a report:
options: Beside the money, on their own
questions.explanation: Intacct's rule, kept exactly.

questions.q: Who requests a new vendor in Nexus?
options: A site that needs one, with the papers; Accounting approves
questions.explanation: Collect the papers before the first visit.

questions.q: An MRE line with no actual for two months usually means:
options: A contract that lapsed, or a vendor that stopped billing; a manager's question
questions.explanation: The expectation beside the ledger is what noticed.

questions.q: Manual Journal Entries marks a system entry a person later changed as:
questions.explanation: It counts too.

questions.q: The Close tab lives under:
questions.explanation: Overview, Cash, Performance, Close.

questions.q: Days to close is shortened most by:
options: The site's clean tickets, numbered invoices, reasoned waivers and same-day answers
questions.explanation: A site that does those four closes its month in a day of the team's time.

questions.q: The Compliance tab's state word Expired means:
options: The vendor does no work on site until the new paper is filed
questions.explanation: One rule, read on the vendor record and the construction Subs tab alike.
